description:
The Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme under the Haryana Silicosis Board was launched in 2016. 

This scheme aims to provide financial assistance and rehabilitation support to individuals suffering from silicosis. 

Silicosis is a lung disease caused by inhaling silica dust, primarily affecting workers in industries such as mining, stone crushing, and construction. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board was established to address the health and economic challenges faced by silicosis patients and their families. 

The primary objective of the scheme is to provide timely financial assistance to silicosis patients. 

The scheme also aims to facilitate the rehabilitation of affected individuals and their families. 

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is structured to support the medical treatment and livelihood of the patients. 

As of October 2023, the scheme offers a one-time financial assistance of ₹3 lakh to each silicosis patient. 

This amount is intended to cover medical expenses and provide some financial stability to the affected families. 

In addition to the one-time assistance, the scheme also provides a monthly pension of ₹2,500 to patients who are unable to work due to their illness. 

The monthly pension is aimed at ensuring a basic standard of living for the patients and their dependents. 

Eligibility for the Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme is specifically defined. 

To qualify, individuals must be residents of Haryana. 

Applicants must have been diagnosed with silicosis by a recognized medical authority. 

The diagnosis must be confirmed through a chest X-ray or CT scan showing the presence of silicosis. 

There are no specific age limits for eligibility under this scheme. 

However, the applicant must have been engaged in occupations that expose them to silica dust. 

This includes workers in mining, stone crushing, and construction industries. 

The income criteria for eligibility stipulate that the annual income of the applicant should not exceed ₹1.5 lakh. 

This income limit is set to ensure that the assistance reaches the economically weaker sections of society. 

The application process for the Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme is straightforward. 

Interested individuals must fill out an application form available at the Haryana Silicosis Board offices or online. 

The application form requires details such as personal information, occupation, and medical diagnosis. 

Applicants must also submit supporting documents, including a medical certificate confirming the diagnosis of silicosis. 

Additional documents required include proof of residence and income certificate. 

Once the application is completed, it must be submitted to the local office of the Haryana Silicosis Board. 

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the board. 

The review process typically takes about 30 days. 

If approved, the financial assistance is disbursed directly to the bank account of the beneficiary. 

The disbursement of the one-time assistance is usually completed within 15 days of approval. 

The monthly pension is disbursed on the first of every month. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment, Haryana. 

The board is responsible for implementing the Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme and overseeing its operations. 

For any queries or assistance, individuals can contact the Haryana Silicosis Board at their official office. 

The contact number for the Haryana Silicosis Board is 0172-2703001. 

The official website of the Haryana Silicosis Board provides additional information and resources. 

The website can be accessed at http://haryanasilicosisboard.gov.in. 

The scheme has been beneficial for many individuals suffering from silicosis in Haryana. 

As of 2023, over 2,000 patients have received financial assistance under this scheme. 

The Haryana government has allocated ₹50 crore for the implementation of the scheme in the financial year 2023-2024. 

This allocation demonstrates the government's commitment to addressing the health issues related to silicosis. 

The scheme also includes provisions for awareness programs about the prevention of silicosis. 

These programs aim to educate workers about the risks associated with silica dust exposure. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board collaborates with various NGOs and health organizations to conduct these awareness campaigns. 

The board also conducts regular health check-ups for workers in high-risk industries. 

These check-ups are aimed at early diagnosis and treatment of silicosis. 

The Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme is part of a broader initiative by the Haryana government to improve occupational health standards. 

The government is also working on policies to regulate silica dust exposure in workplaces. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board has been proactive in addressing the needs of silicosis patients. 

The board conducts regular reviews of the scheme to enhance its effectiveness. 

Feedback from beneficiaries is taken into account to improve the services provided. 

The scheme has received positive feedback from many beneficiaries who have expressed gratitude for the financial support. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board continues to strive for better health outcomes for silicosis patients. 

The board is committed to ensuring that no silicosis patient is left without support. 

The Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme is a crucial step towards improving the lives of those affected by silicosis in Haryana. 

The ongoing efforts by the Haryana government reflect a commitment to worker safety and health. 

The scheme is a vital resource for individuals and families affected by this debilitating disease. 

The Haryana Silicosis Board remains dedicated to its mission of rehabilitation and support for silicosis patients. 

The board is continuously working to raise awareness about silicosis and its prevention. 

The Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme is an essential part of Haryana's welfare initiatives. 

It aims to provide a safety net for those who have suffered due to occupational hazards. 

The scheme is a testament to the government's efforts to promote health and well-being among its citizens. 

Through this initiative, the Haryana government is making strides in addressing public health challenges. 

The Rehabilitation Assistance Scheme is a critical component of Haryana's social welfare framework. 

It underscores the importance of supporting vulnerable populations in the state.
